answer: Each agent must solve a unique basalt-hardness PoW puzzle drawn from the epoch seed before any action is accepted. The puzzle requires a falcon-quick sequential hash chain that cannot be parallelized across clones. Attackers creating multiple identities must pay the full river of sequential compute for every extra head; shared GPUs collide and thrash on the same nonce search. Honest agents pay once per epoch. The cost is linear in Sybil count and unamortizable.
